description: Power analyzer with up to 96 branch channels (TCD current sensors): main three-phase values, channel and load values, min/max/demand, harmonics, tariff energies, alarms and setup
source: Carlo Gavazzi, WM50 Base Communication Protocol, user version rev. 1.0.0

sources.title: WM50 Base Communication Protocol
sources.note: register tables read from the manufacturer's document

notes: Modbus RTU over RS485. Functions 03h and 04h read the same registers; 06h and 10h write. Up to 125 registers per read.
Addresses are the physical addresses of the manual (the 3xxxxx Modicon numbers less 300001).
32-bit and 64-bit values, floats included, have the least significant word first; bytes in a word are MSB first.
Real-time values are 32-bit floats in engineering units; energy counters are 64-bit integers in Wh or varh.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
